description:
The reps steppers on a weighted exercise use the .step.small size (34px) while every other primary control in the session card is 44px. They are hit mid-set, one-handed, so they are the wrong place to economise on target size.

Check the surrounding layout arithmetic when raising them: the session card is sized against a 390px budget and the weighted branch puts a weight stepper, a big number and the reps column on one row.
title: Raise the reps stepper to 44px
